items.exampleEn: Social media has an impact on how we see ourselves.
items.exampleZh: 社群媒體會影響我們怎麼看待自己。

items.exampleEn: Ms. Ho is in charge of training new staff.
items.exampleZh: 何小姐負責訓練新進員工。

items.exampleEn: Please buy your tickets in advance.
In terms of price, this phone is the best choice.
items.exampleZh: 就價格而言，這支手機是最好的選擇。

items.exampleEn: It's hard to keep track of everything.
items.exampleZh: 要掌握每一件事的狀況很難。

items.exampleEn: It costs a lot of money to launch a product.
items.exampleZh: 推出一項產品要花很多錢。

items.exampleEn: It's easy to lose track of the date on vacation.
items.exampleZh: 放假時很容易忘了今天是幾號。

items.sentenceEn: The two hotels are similar in terms of comfort.
items.sentenceZh: 這兩家飯店在舒適度方面差不多。

items.audioEn: Mr. Chen is in charge of the sales team, so please send your questions to him.
items.audioZh: 陳先生負責業務團隊，所以請把你的問題寄給他。
options: The receptionist at the front desk downstairs
The person who leads the sales team

items.sentenceEn: I've lost track of most of my old classmates.
items.sentenceZh: 我和大部分的老同學都失去聯絡了。

items.sentenceEn: I keep track of my spending in a notebook.
items.sentenceZh: 我用筆記本記錄自己的花費。

items.stemEn: The two plans are very different ____ cost.
items.stemZh: 這兩個計畫在費用方面差很多。

items.stemEn: Small daily choices can ____ the environment.
items.stemZh: 日常的小選擇也會對環境有影響。

items.passageEn: Next month, our small company will launch a product that we have worked on for two years: a smart key holder. Lena, our marketing manager, has planned every event in advance. The holder keeps track of your keys and sends a message to your phone if you leave them behind. In terms of design, it is simple and light. It will be sold online and in about fifty shops around the country. We hope many people will find it useful.
items.passageZh: 下個月，我們這家小公司將推出一項研發了兩年的產品：智慧鑰匙座。我們的行銷經理 Lena 已經事先規劃好每一場活動。這個鑰匙座會掌握你鑰匙的動態，如果你忘了帶走，它會傳訊息到你的手機。在設計方面，它簡單又輕巧。它會在網路上和全國大約五十家商店販售。我們希望很多人會覺得它很實用。

questions.questionZh: 這個新產品有什麼功能？
options: 可以用手機遠端打開家裡的門鎖
幫你記錄每天喝多少水
忘了帶鑰匙時會傳訊息到手機
找到願意投資的大公司
請名人在網路上介紹產品

items.promptZh: 如果你要來，請事先告訴我。
referenceEn: If you're coming, please tell me in advance.
Please let me know in advance if you are coming.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「事先」（例如 in advance 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 beforehand、ahead of time 等）
「告訴我」可寫，例如 tell me、let me know 等
「如果你要來」可寫，例如 if you're coming、if you come 等

items.promptZh: 這本書太好看了，我都忘了時間。
referenceEn: The book was so interesting that I lost track of time.
I enjoyed the book so much that I lost track of time.
rubricZh: 建議用片語表達「忘了時間」（例如 lost track of time 等）
不用片語但意思正確的說法也算對（例如 forgot about the time、didn't notice the time 等）
時態可用過去式或現在式（例如 was、is；lost 等）
「太好看了」可寫，例如 so interesting that、enjoyed it so much that 等

resolvedAfterFinalReview.message: 審題員 issue 結案：評分要點把 if you will come 列為可接受寫法。表示未來的條件子句一般用現在式（if you're coming / if you come），if you will come 不合標準文法，不該當範例；建議改成 if you come。
resolvedAfterFinalReview.resolution: 已修正：評分要點的例子改為 if you're coming、if you come 等（拿掉文法不正確的 if you will come）
